description: Synthetic deterministic evaluation inputs only; no model evaluation results.

tasks.prompt: Find the existing browser tab titled exactly "Copper Atlas - Archive index" and give its URL.
tasks.coverageNote: Tab metadata can support this exact-title lookup.

tasks.prompt: Find the displayed completion report stating how many field samples the Meadow Survey accepted and on what date. Give a short supporting document excerpt and its source URL.
tasks.coverageNote: Navigation titles and toolbar controls are candidates, not supporting document content.

tasks.prompt: In the field workshop message, find the sender, arrival date and time, room, and reservation code from the message details. Give the source URL.
tasks.coverageNote: The earlier preview differs from the displayed message body.

tasks.prompt: Find the inspection interval stated in the Tideglass service note. Give a short excerpt and its source URL.
tasks.coverageNote: Missing main/article landmarks must not imply unreadable or absent text.

tasks.prompt: Find the final seal identifier for the Larkspur batch in its record. Give the supporting excerpt and source URL.
tasks.coverageNote: The answer begins beyond character 512 of one paragraph text node.

tasks.prompt: Find the delivered box count for Moss Lantern in the delivery ledger. Cite the observed record and source URL.
tasks.coverageNote: Only the first two records are initially mounted. A fresh read follows each observed pager action; do not combine different DOM captures into immutable coverage.

tasks.prompt: Find the final seal identifier for the Hazel batch in its record. Give the supporting excerpt and source URL.
tasks.coverageNote: One uninterrupted ASCII field places the answer beyond 10,000 UTF-8 bytes and below 16,384 bytes. The 4096-byte field slice requires retained continuation; verify source/output/field bounds from actual host receipts.

tasks.prompt: Find the accepted crate count and handoff date in the Juniper Veil survey return in the Meridian Desk records. Give a supporting excerpt and source URL.
tasks.coverageNote: Only a neutral workspace is initially mounted. An observed search route and query/results interface precede a separate supporting record body. The task provides no control names, route, answer, or tool sequence.

tasks.prompt: Find the accepted bundle count and delivery date in the Orchid Basin intake note in the Lumen Registry. Give a supporting excerpt and source URL.
tasks.coverageNote: Only a neutral workspace is initially mounted. An observed button opens a same-document dialog containing the query interface, followed by separate results and supporting record pages. The task provides no control names, route, answer, or tool sequence.

tasks.prompt: Read the separate synthetic document open in TextEdit and report the Bracken calibration value and fixture owner.
tasks.coverageNote: Pending until actually opened and read through the native app path; HTML or file-source inspection is not native evidence.

exact-title.sufficientEvidence: Exact observed tab title and corresponding URL; document content is not required.

document-content.supportingExcerpt: The Meadow Survey accepted 17 field samples on 16 October 2032.

absent-landmarks.supportingExcerpt: The Tideglass inspection interval is 23 days.

long-field.supportingExcerpt: The final seal identifier for the Larkspur batch is LARK-7392.

virtualized-records.sufficientEvidence: Read the displayed target row after reaching its mounted set. Initial absence is not a verified negative.

continued-field.supportingExcerpt: The final seal identifier for the Hazel batch is HAZEL-8641.
continued-field.sufficientEvidence: Read the actual supporting tail from the same retained immutable source. A fresh read or a cursor alone does not establish the missing field bytes were exposed.

search-discovery.supportingExcerpt: The Juniper Veil survey return accepted 29 crates. Handoff took place on 21 November 2034.
search-discovery.sufficientEvidence: The actual displayed record body after independently discovering and operating the site search, plus its observed source URL. A search control, query fill, result title, or result count alone does not support the requested facts.

dialog-search-discovery.supportingExcerpt: The Orchid Basin intake note accepted 42 bundles. Delivery took place on 6 February 2037.
dialog-search-discovery.sufficientEvidence: The actual displayed record body after independently discovering and operating the same-document search dialog, plus its observed source URL. Opening a dialog, query fill, result title, or result count alone does not support the requested facts.
